name: Exp_wlxBW5Zone
summary: This EA trades based on the wlxBW5Zone custom indicator, which appears to be a Bill Williams Zone-based momentum indicator. It opens buy positions on upward zone signals and sell positions on downward zone signals, with configurable entry/exit toggles, fixed stop loss/take profit, and multiple money management modes.
summary_zh: 该EA基于wlxBW5Zone自定义指标进行交易，该指标似乎是基于比尔·威廉姆斯区域的动量指标。它在上方区域信号时开多仓，在下方区域信号时开空仓，具有可配置的入场/出场开关、固定止损止盈以及多种资金管理模式。
strategy_analysis: 策略概念基于Bill Williams的5维区域理论（wlxBW5Zone指标），通过检测动量区域变化来捕捉趋势方向。入场条件为：当指标上轨缓冲区（buffer 1）在指定信号K线上产生非零且非空值时开多仓，当指标下轨缓冲区（buffer 0）产生信号时开空仓。出场条件包括固定止损（1000点）和止盈（2000点），同时支持反向信号平仓——当持仓方向与新区号信号相反时关闭现有仓位。仓位管理提供了五种模式：基于可用保证金、基于余额、基于净可用保证金、基于净余额和固定手数模式。资金管理通过MM参数控制风险比例，MMMode参数选择计算模式。EA还实现了新K线检测机制（IsNewBar），避免同一K线内重复交易，并通过历史数据加载确保指标计算完整性。
strategy_analysis_en: The strategy concept is based on Bill Williams' 5-dimensional zone theory via the wlxBW5Zone indicator, detecting momentum zone changes to capture trend direction. Entry conditions: a buy position opens when the upper buffer (buffer 1) produces a non-zero, non-EMPTY_VALUE signal on the specified signal bar; a sell position opens on the lower buffer (buffer 0) signal. Exit conditions include fixed stop loss (1000 points) and take profit (2000 points), plus reverse-signal closing where existing positions are closed when a contrary zone signal appears. Position sizing supports five modes: free margin-based, balance-based, net free margin, net balance, and fixed lot size. Money management is controlled via the MM parameter for risk proportion and MMMode for the calculation mode. The EA implements a new bar detection mechanism (IsNewBar) to prevent duplicate trades within the same bar, and loads historical data to ensure complete indicator calculation. Additionally, a retrospective loop scans historical bars to detect prior close signals when no current close signal is generated but both open and close flags are enabled.

parameters.name: MM
parameters.description: 资金管理比例或固定手数

parameters.name: MMMode
parameters.description: 仓位计算模式（保证金/余额/净保证金/净余额/固定手数）
parameters.description_en: Margin mode: free margin/balance/drawdown free margin/drawdown balance/fixed lot

parameters.name: BuyPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow buy position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: SellPosClose
parameters.description_en: Allow sell position close on reverse signal

parameters.name: Dir
parameters.description: 指标方向过滤（开启/关闭）

parameters.name: SignalBar
parameters.description: 用于检测信号的K线索引

pros: 具有完整的止损止盈机制，风险可控
支持五种仓位计算模式，资金管理灵活
新K线检测机制避免同K线内重复交易，减少过度交易风险
买卖方向可独立开关，策略配置灵活
反向信号平仓功能提供额外的出场保护
pros_en: Complete stop loss and take profit mechanism provides controllable risk
Five position sizing modes offer flexible money management
New bar detection prevents duplicate trades within the same bar, reducing overtrading
Buy and sell directions can be independently toggled for flexible strategy configuration
Reverse-signal closing provides additional exit protection
cons: 止损1000点和止盈2000点固定值偏大，缺乏根据市场波动性动态调整的机制
历史回溯循环（第146-167行）可能在大历史数据量时导致性能问题
没有持仓检查机制，可能在已有同方向持仓时重复开仓
依赖外部TradeAlgorithms.mqh库，核心交易逻辑不可见且难以审计
没有点差过滤，在高点差环境下信号可能被噪声触发
cons_en: Fixed SL/TP of 1000/2000 points is large and lacks dynamic adjustment based on market volatility
The historical bar retrospective loop (lines 146-167) may cause performance issues with large bar counts
No existing position check before opening new trades, risking duplicate positions in the same direction
Depends on external TradeAlgorithms.mqh library whose core trade logic is invisible and hard to audit
No spread filter means signals may be triggered by noise in high-spread environments
improvements: 增加ATR动态止损止盈，根据市场波动性自动调整止损止盈距离
增加持仓检查和最大持仓数限制，防止同方向重复开仓和过度暴露
增加点差过滤条件，在点差过大时暂停交易以避免滑点损失
improvements_en: Add ATR-based dynamic stop loss/take profit to automatically adjust distances based on market volatility
Add position checking and maximum position limits to prevent duplicate same-direction entries and overexposure
Add a spread filter to pause trading when spreads are too wide, avoiding slippage losses

risk_points: 无持仓检查可能导致同方向重复开仓，增大风险敞口
固定止损1000点在低波动市场可能过大，在高波动市场可能过小
历史回溯循环无上限保护，极端情况下可能遍历大量K线导致延迟
risk_points_en: No position check may lead to duplicate same-direction entries, increasing risk exposure
Fixed 1000-point SL may be too large in low-volatility markets and too small in high-volatility markets
The retrospective loop has no upper bound protection; extreme cases may iterate over massive bar counts causing delays
